messages.subject: Vholes — advice note for the Board
messages.plaintextBody:
Lorna, Iqbal, Daniel,

Attached is our advice note for Friday's Board, together with the settlement breakdown spreadsheet. Headline: I recommend agreeing a reduced 9-month non-compete in exchange for the wider settlement — a covenant we can actually enforce is worth more than a longer one a court may strike out. The opening package totals around £254,000 before employer NIC.

Happy to attend by video for item 3.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
